gloss: beginning of the year, New Year

definitions.gloss: beginning of the year, New Year
definitions.explanation: The first days of the new calendar year, typically referring to early January.

examples.japanese: {年始|ねんし}の{挨拶|あいさつ}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: I'm going to make a New Year greeting visit.

examples.japanese: {年始|ねんし}は{親戚|しんせき}の{家|いえ}を{回|まわ}る{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: I plan to visit my relatives' homes at the start of the new year.

examples.japanese: {年末年始|ねんまつねんし}の{休|やす}みは{実家|じっか}で{過|す}ごすことにしている。
examples.english: I always spend the year-end and New Year holidays at my parents' house.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly appears in the compound {年末年始|ねんまつねんし} (year-end and New Year period). On its own, {年始|ねんし} often refers specifically to the custom of visiting people to exchange New Year greetings ({年始回|ねんしまわ}り).

CULTURAL NOTE:
{年始|ねんし}の{挨拶|あいさつ} (New Year greetings) is an important social custom in Japan. People visit relatives, neighbors, and business associates in early January. In business contexts, companies may send {年始|ねんし} greeting cards or make courtesy calls.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年始|ねんし}の{挨拶|あいさつ}: New Year greeting
- {年始回|ねんしまわ}り: rounds of New Year visits
- {年末年始|ねんまつねんし}: year-end and New Year period
- {年始|ねんし}{休暇|きゅうか}: New Year holidays
